title: Edit repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/vessel-mitosis-cutover.ts: before the systemctl restart of the target vessel
description: Edit repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/vessel-mitosis-cutover.ts: before the systemctl restart of the target vessel, query that vessel's /health endpoint for its in_flight count; if the target has fresh in-flight work (a non-cutover dispatch currently executing), defer the restart through the existing change-window lease deferral path so it retries on a later tick, instead of restarting now and interrupting that work. Only count fresh in-flight work, bounded like the drain's freshMs, so a stale or immortal in-flight record can never block the restart forever.
